title: Insulin and Injection Supply Pharmacy Program Returns: Authorization, Receipt and Credit
content:
On the Insulin and Injection Supply Pharmacy Program the return window is 0 on every tier, so no dispensed insulin or injection supply is ever authorized for return.

## Return authorization

(a) Larkfield accepts a return only of items that are unopened and in their original sealed packaging — a fact the customer states about the items concerned; opened medical supplies are never returned to stock or credited on any tier where opened items are not returnable, because a supply that has left Larkfield's control cannot be re-dispensed to another patient.

(b) A return is authorized only when the customer asks for it no later than the tier's return window in calendar days after the delivery date on the proof of delivery for that shipment, counted in calendar days from that delivery date with the last day allowed; a shipment without a proof of delivery cannot be returned, and a package damaged in transit is handled as a replacement, not a return.

(c) The units authorized for return never exceed the units of that shipment, less any units of it already authorized for return.

## Return receipt and credit

(d) When the warehouse accepts the returned units as unopened and sealed, the units are credited back to the authorization they were drawn from; a payer-billed shipment is then re-billed by a void claim (all units returned) or a corrected claim (some units returned), and a self-pay shipment is credited to the customer's balance at the price paid for the returned units less the tier's restocking fee percent.

(e) Returned units the warehouse finds opened are not accepted and no receipt is recorded.

## Packages returned undelivered by the carrier

(f) A package the carrier brings back undelivered is received as a return receipt without a return authorization; its insulin is destroyed rather than restocked, its units are credited back to the prescription, and its claim is reversed by a void claim or, on the self-pay tier, credited in full with no restocking fee.

## Decision table

| Request or event | Outcome under these rules |
|---|---|
| Customer asks to return unopened, sealed units of a delivered shipment | Not authorized: with a return window of 0 calendar days, no dispensed insulin or injection supply is authorized for return |
| Customer asks to return a shipment with no proof of delivery | Cannot be returned |
| Customer reports a package damaged in transit | Handled as a replacement, not a return |
| Warehouse finds returned units opened | Not accepted; no receipt recorded |
| Carrier brings a package back undelivered | Return receipt without authorization; insulin destroyed; units credited back; claim voided, or on the self-pay tier credited in full with no restocking fee |
